links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses measured with 12 readability metrics across four chatbots
links.effect: Google Bard led in 75% of readability metrics assessed; ChatGPT scored highest on rubric criteria including comprehension. Specific reading grade levels are not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: However, Google Bard excelled in readability, leading in 75% of the metrics assessed.

links.outcome: Specialist-rated patient risk from LLM responses to cornea scenarios
links.effect: Three blinded cornea specialists found no responses that posed risks to patients; ChatGPT scored overall 3.35 ± 0.42 (83.8%).
links.quote: Importantly, no responses were found to pose risks to patients, ensuring the safety and reliability of the information provided.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates multiple commercial LLMs on cornea clinic prompts using expert physician grading and readability metrics, but it does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
